title: Ahaziah (king of Israel)
summary: Son of Ahab, king of Israel.
description: Son of Ahab, king of Israel. Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-16 (Table 2, "The Kings of Qatna"); its dates are display only.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

standby.note: Standby placement only. Chronological Framework of Ancient History prints this BC/AD year on the reign entry (Reign: 898-896). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-16: The Kings of Israel and Judah," OSF preprint v1.3 (5 May 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/YV29C, file CFAH-16_ The Kings of Israel and Judah_v1.3.pdf, Table 2 "The Kings of Qatna", pp. 13–14
reign.note: Row "Akizzi = Ahaziah" of Table 2 (Kings of Qatna = kings of Israel (CFAH-16)).
